entries.description: Confirmed gating: Authentication:SeededSession:Enabled=true is Dev/Test only (validator), loopback-only, X-Test-Auth-Secret header required. Existing dev secret pattern preserved for Quick Sign-In via JS interop.

Created TestAuthClient service facade at src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Services/DevTools/TestAuthClient.cs. Deviated from spec 'typed HttpClient' wording: in Blazor Server, HttpContext is null during interactive events, so forwarding the auth cookie for a server-to-self loopback call would require extra circuit-scoped plumbing. The facade calls IUserSessionContextService and DevEmailInbox directly; endpoints remain for external/headless use. SessionInfoSnapshot + SessionOrganizationSnapshot DTOs match /test-auth/session-info shape.

Created Components/Shared/DevTools/DevToolsMenu.razor: MudMenu with BugReport warning icon, renders nothing when SeededSession.Enabled=false; renders three items (Quick Sign-In, Session Info, Magic Links) when enabled, each opening a MudDialog.
Created QuickSignInDialog.razor: ports the six-persona list from Login.razor, uses existing wwwroot/dev-quick-signin.js for the seeded-session call (so the cookie lands on the browser).
Created SessionInfoDialog.razor: pretty-prints session JSON in a scrollable <pre>, Refresh action re-fetches via TestAuthClient.GetSessionInfoAsync().
Created MagicLinksDialog.razor: MudTable with Email/Code/Captured columns, Copy-Link via navigator.clipboard.writeText JS interop, Open-in-new-tab, filter input, Clear-inbox button.

Inserted <DevToolsMenu /> in MainLayout.razor immediately before <UserContextBar /> in the MudAppBar. Registered TestAuthClient as scoped in Program.cs only when Authentication:SeededSession:Enabled=true in Dev/Test.

Wrote 19 tests across 4 files: DevToolsMenuTests (gate on/off), MagicLinksDialogTests (empty state, populated rows, non-MagicLink exclusion, filter narrowing, clear button, copy JS interop), TestAuthClientTests (unauthenticated, authenticated, magic-link filtering, ordering, clear, IsEnabled), DevToolsEndpointContractTests (session-info shape, magic-links capture/clear, both reject missing secret).

dotnet build clean. dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln: all 19 new tests pass; 627/628 total tests pass. The one failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates) is pre-existing — verified by stashing and running the same test on master; it looks for docs/workflow-auth-observability.md which does not exist in the repo. Not caused by this session.

End-of-session verification via route(task_type='session-verification'). Round 1 returned ISSUES_FOUND with 1 Critical + 3 Major + 5 Minor findings. Addressed: M1 (unconditional TestAuthClient registration), M2 (verified DevEmailInbox singleton), m3/m4/m5 (fixes). Deferred with rationale: C1 (spec-mandated JS-interop pattern), M3 (MudMenu popover not expandable in bUnit), m1 (spec-deferred). Round 2 returned VERIFIED.
